TOWER OF HANOI: BEYOND INFINITY - third-party components and assets
====================================================================

Code and assets created for this project
  * All game code, the application icon (generated by tools/make_icon.py), every sound effect and
    every music loop (synthesised at run time by src/audio_synth.py) are original works released
    under the MIT licence in LICENSE.txt.
  * No third-party image, font or audio files are bundled. Text is drawn with fonts that are already
    installed on the player's system (Segoe UI on Windows). If you drop a .ttf/.otf file into
    assets/fonts/ the game will use it instead - remember to add its licence here.

Libraries bundled into the Windows build
  * pygame (https://www.pygame.org) - GNU LGPL v2.1. The library is distributed unmodified, as separate
    files inside the game folder, so it can be replaced by the user with another compatible pygame build.
  * SDL2, SDL2_image, SDL2_mixer, SDL2_ttf and their codecs (shipped inside the pygame wheel) -
    zlib and other permissive licences; see the licence files that accompany the pygame package.
  * PyInstaller (https://pyinstaller.org) - used to build the executable; its bootloader is covered by
    a GPL licence with an exception that permits distributing the produced executables under any terms.
  * CPython runtime - Python Software Foundation License.

Please review the licence texts shipped inside the pygame package (pygame\LICENSE or the wheel metadata)
before redistributing the game commercially.

Historical note
  * The Tower of Hanoi puzzle was introduced by Edouard Lucas in 1883.
